title: Bakuretsu Hunter
overview:
Bakuretsu Hunter, played out in a slightly naughty game starring your old favorites Carrot, Marron, Tira and the rest! A gorgeous voice cast is here too!!

You can only enjoy this in this game!

Based on the Bakuretsu Hunter anime, this adventure follows the Sorcerer Hunters, who stand up for ordinary people against the tyranny of sorcerers. Follow the story through visual novel scenes that draw on part of the TV series' scenario, with a star voice cast bringing the team to life.

The game also offers minigames against the computer. Doppel Gokko is a flag-raising game between the red and blue teams - simple or tricky, you be the judge. Slot Battle turns a slot machine into a fight, with the reels deciding hits and misses as your hunters trade blows - and it lets you see Tira and Chocolat in their most daring outfits.

- Visual novel adventure based on the anime
- Doppel Gokko flag-raising minigame
- Slot Battle slot machine fights
- Two discs

お馴染みのキャロット、マロン、ティラたちがゲームの中で繰り広げる、ちょっとエッチな爆れつハンター!豪華声優陣もバッチリ登場!!

このゲームでしか楽しめないっ!
